title: Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star with Lulu and Fireflies | Nursery Rhyme
description:
Sing along to Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star with Lulu the little duck and Pip the kitten on a warm summer evening! Little fireflies glow on every "twinkle" and Puppy trots in to listen.
The words light up with the music, for children aged 2 to 6.
A classic nursery rhyme (words by Jane Taylor, 1806; traditional French tune, 1761).
